description_expanded:
This welcome addition to the rental program sits in a great location with direct access in front of the home to the turtles of the Turtle Bale pedestrian path leading to a short walk to the Gulf. The first-floor courtyard offers seating and one of the nicest, private exterior showers at Alys Beach. Entering the home on the first floor, you will find the primary bedroom suite with a king-sized bed and a large walk-in closet. In addition, there are two queen-sized bedrooms that both offer ensuite bathrooms. A small single bed is located in an alcove off of the main hallway. On the second floor guests will enjoy the dining area along with the kitchen and living room. Just off of the living room you will find a covered sitting area with fireplace and TV, along with a lovely view of the Turtle Bale pedestrian path. There is an additional screened sitting area with a built-in gas grill just off of the kitchen. The fourth bedroom is found at the end of the hallway that features a queen-sized bed with ensuite bathroom. Finally, on the second floor, there is a plunge pool to enjoy. This home has two dedicated parking spaces located in a parking court behind the home. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 32 Kings Castle Court. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
